title: Pinterest Pin Search - Image URLs & Destination Domains
description: Minimal input: {"queries": ["home office"], "maxPinsPerQuery": 3}. Each parsed source response costs $0.008 plus $0.001 per delivered row. Empty/unchanged successful checks are billed. maxTotalChargeUsd belongs in Apify run options.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Public pin search keywords, for example ["home office","ceramic mugs"]. Up to 20. Each parsed page costs $0.008 plus $0.001 per delivered pin. This is keyword search, not a board/profile URL input.

maxPinsPerQuery.title: Maximum pins per query
maxPinsPerQuery.description: Output ceiling per original source, for example 50. Applied after filters, exclusions and monitoring. Each delivered row costs $0.001; source checks are separate. Fewer rows may exist. Duplicate results across sources are delivered only once.

textContains.title: Text includes any phrase
textContains.description: Keep results containing any phrase, case-insensitive; for example ["office"] or ["free"]. Checks title, description and alt text. Empty [] accepts all. Applied before row charging; successful source checks still cost money.

textExcludes.title: Text excludes any phrase
textExcludes.description: Drop results containing any phrase, for example ["download"] or ["bedroom"]. Empty [] disables the filter. Filtered rows are not charged; successful source checks remain billable.

onlyWithDestinationUrl.title: Require an external destination URL
onlyWithDestinationUrl.description: false by default. true keeps only pins with a source-provided HTTP(S) destination link. Missing links are never inferred. Filtered pins have no row fee; parsed pages remain billable at $0.008.

destinationDomains.title: Destination domains
destinationDomains.description: Allow hostnames such as ["etsy.com","youtube.com"], including their subdomains. Do not include https:// or paths. Empty [] disables filtering. Pins without destinations are excluded when this filter is active. No row charge for exclusions.

imageOrientation.title: Image orientation
imageOrientation.description: "any" (default), "portrait", "landscape" or "square", based on source image dimensions. Active filters exclude unknown dimensions. No extra filtering fee; only matching pins incur the row fee.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Maximum search pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Safety cap, for example 3. Range 1–10. A parsed page costs $0.008 even with no matching or new pins, usually with up to 25 source records. Stops on repeated pages/tokens. The result or request cap may stop earlier.

onlyNew.title: Only new results
onlyNew.description: false by default. true saves delivered IDs under monitorKey; later runs skip them. The first run returns the baseline. Successful checks still cost $0.008 each even with no new rows. Use an Apify schedule for recurring checks; this flag creates no schedule.

monitorKey.title: Monitor name
monitorKey.description: Name such as "daily-research"; default "default". Reuse it for repeat runs. Targets, date window, locale and filters automatically form a separate baseline when changed. Keeps the latest 50,000 IDs per scope. Do not overlap runs with the same name and scope.

excludeIds.title: Previously collected IDs
excludeIds.description: Optional output id values, for example ["previous-output-id"]. Up to 10,000. Empty [] excludes nothing. Useful for caller-managed deduplication. Excluded rows are not charged; parsed source checks are.

maxRequests.title: Maximum HTTP requests
maxRequests.description: Hard run-wide source request cap, for example 100; range 1–200. The initial public-session handshake uses one request before the first page, so at least 2 are needed for any pins. This is not a dollar limit. Set maxTotalChargeUsd as an Apify run option for a monetary cap.
